This track is the experimental core of the thesis. It fine-tunes NVIDIA
GR00T on the OARbot demonstration dataset, trains Hugging Face VLA
baselines (SmolVLA, π0 via LeRobot) on the same data, and runs the
head-to-head evaluation on the complex-task suite — success rate,
generalization to unseen task variations, and data efficiency. Its
results populate the Methods chapter and drive the thesis's central
claims about learning from demonstration for complex tasks.
